description: This file implements a Python code style checker for WebKit, utilizing pep8 and pylint, and defines the class PythonChecker for style validation.

classes.name: PythonChecker
classes.description: A class that processes Python files to check style using pep8 and pylint.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes PythonChecker with a file path and error handler.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs style checks using pep8 and pylint.

methods.name: _check_pep8
methods.description: Runs pep8 style checks on the file.

methods.name: _check_pylint
methods.description: Runs pylint style checks on the file.

methods.name: run_pylint
methods.description: Executes pylint as a subprocess and returns its output.

methods.name: _parse_pylint_output
methods.description: Parses pylint output to extract error information, filtering out false positives.
